attractions.name: Sanur Harbour
attractions.description: Departure point for speedboat transfers to Nusa Penida. Speedboats generally operate from 7:30 AM onwards. The scenic boat journey across the Bali Strait takes approximately 35–45 minutes.
source_files: Bali Indonesia/Apurva_Bali _All Inclusive Guide.docx
Bali Indonesia/05062026_Apurva_Bali _All Inclusive Guide.docx

attractions.name: Sanur Boardwalk
attractions.description: A beachfront boardwalk stretching along the coastline, lined with palm trees, beach cafés, boutique resorts, and ocean views. Offers a wonderful opportunity to enjoy the laid-back atmosphere of Sanur.
source_files: Bali Indonesia/Peter - Bali - All Inclusive Guide.docx

attractions.name: ICON Bali Mall
attractions.description: Sanur's newest lifestyle and shopping destination combining international brands, local boutiques, cafés, restaurants, and entertainment spaces within a stylish beachfront setting.
source_files: Bali Indonesia/Peter - Bali - All Inclusive Guide.docx

attractions.name: Krisna Oleh-Oleh Bali Sanur
attractions.description: One of Bali's most popular souvenir stores offering fixed prices and an extensive selection of Balinese products including coffee, chocolates, batik clothing, handmade crafts, and spa products.
source_files: Bali Indonesia/Peter - Bali - All Inclusive Guide.docx

attractions.name: Sindhu Night Market
attractions.description: One of Sanur's most popular local night markets. Features freshly grilled satay, local delicacies, tropical fruits, and Indonesian desserts. One of the best places to experience authentic local life and sample traditional Indonesian street food.
source_files: Bali Indonesia/Peter - Bali - All Inclusive Guide.docx

local_dishes.name: Mango Sticky Rice

local_dishes.name: Street Food Favourites

transport_options.description: Speedboat transfer from Sanur Harbour to Nusa Penida across the Bali Strait. Journey takes approximately 35–45 minutes. Boats generally operate from 7:30 AM onwards.
